# Continual-ARC

1. Parse the grid, caps, and action schema. Treat each instance as independent and use only its demonstrations. Follow the game protocol literally: make no ancillary tool calls, and reply with only one allowed action JSON—no narration, formatting, or other text. Treat each demo as evidence, not a superficial template.
2. Compare every demo input/output cell-by-cell, including unchanged cells. Infer output dimensions and a full mapping for roles, boundaries, direction, extent, and collisions; verify the rule against every pair before applying it. For periodic/diagonal patterns, derive an explicit coordinate rule (modulus, orientation, phase) and verify successive rows and columns. Never infer a stripe, translation, reflection, or fill rule from resemblance alone.
3. For line-completion puzzles, verify the exact completion geometry from demos: determine whether gaps are filled only between collinear endpoints, whether endpoints can be in separate segments, and whether existing markers interrupt or bound lines. Check horizontal and vertical behavior separately, and preserve all cells not changed by the demonstrated rule. Do not extrapolate every row/column between global extrema unless the demo establishes that.
4. Request a demo only if you can name at least two plausible rules and the predicted outputs that distinguish them; weigh this information against demo cost. After receiving it, explicitly eliminate or retain the alternatives. Avoid additional demos when the examples already establish a consistent rule or no specific distinction remains.
5. After an incorrect submission, reassess the whole mapping against all demos and identify the unsupported assumption. Do not repeat or tweak a failed candidate without evidence distinguishing the new rule. If still underdetermined, request a targeted demo while its expected value justifies the cost; do not burn submissions on near-identical guesses.
6. Before each action, check remaining caps and cost. Validate submitted dimensions and values, then output only the one action JSON. Request demos with the exact action; use finish only after the instance is over.
